maddeler.e:
نحقوقف (form XII)
# نَحْقَوْقِفُ (naḥqawqifu) /naħ.qaw.qi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# نَحْقَوْقِفَ (naḥqawqifa) /naħ.qaw.qi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# نَحْقَوْقِفْ (naḥqawqif) /naħ.qaw.qif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
